store_configure: Select1MiB..16MiB journal budget before first store operation; default1MiB. The first execute/view attempt freezes configuration; later configure returns16. Full256-row history in this task needs4194304 bytes.
store_operation: Execute actions0list/1init/2reserve/3cancel on the selected path. Writer gets saved JSON on success. Errors: invalid22, duplicate17, missing row404, stale/overlap409, busy35, capacity27, corrupt9001, uncertain9002. Missing FILE returns native2; CLI can map2 to404. Reset/write Writer only after success.
store_view: Returns a fresh owned Bookings value after closing the read descriptor. Use handle / ok own rows:Bookings / err cause / end. Do not copy owners. State receives observed revision/version/digest. No mutations.
StoreRequest: Record fields are unsigned. action0list/1init/2reserve/3cancel, expected revision, numeric positive id, room1..16, Gregorian ordinal day, start0..1439, finish1..1440. Use same-day half-open intervals.
StoreState: Construct StoreState(0,0,0,0,0,0,0). revision is saved revision; version is codec1/2. committed can signal save uncertainty; never turn an error into success.
Writer: Construct Writer(buffer("unique",65536),65536,0,0). data/capacity/used/error. Static buffer is reused, not allocated fresh. Check error before output; do not guess used length or copy a different buffer.
writer_text: Append a zero-terminated string. Sets out.error on insufficient space; does not print. Use writer_bytes for explicit non-terminated spans.
writer_json: Append one quoted/escaped JSON string from an explicit byte span. Escapes all ASCII control bytes. Input UTF8 must already be valid; this isn't a Unicode validator.
writer_html: Append HTML-escaped validated text from an explicit byte span; no automatic document structure or trusted raw markup conversion.
io_write_all: Recoverable full write or IO error. In an IO function use do try io_write_all(1,out.data,out.used). Never print success before persistence succeeds. A closed output may leave a prefix.
text_parse_u64: Canonical unsigned decimal with explicit maximum. Format errors22, overflow/exceeds-max75. For the task's input contract map either to22. Positive IDs/revisions must separately refuse zero.
date_parse: Exact YYYY-MM-DD -> numericYYYYMMDD. Then date_ordinal(key) -> Gregorian ordinal. Handle errors as invalid input; no timezone or recurring dates.
date_ordinal: Convert validated numericYYYYMMDD to ordinal1..3652059. Use date_parse first for text. Return type IO; let day=try date_ordinal(key).
time_parse: Exact HH:MM -> minutes. allow_end1 permits24:00 for end only. start must be below finish and on the same day.
ui_date_key: Reverse valid Gregorian ordinal to numericYYYYMMDD for date_format. This is scalar, not an IO result.
date_format: Append YYYY-MM-DD to Writer from numericYYYYMMDD, not ordinal. Convert ordinal with ui_date_key first.
time_format: Append HH:MM from valid minute count;1440 renders24:00. No timezone conversion.
form_session: Create unpredictable process-local32-character CSRF token. Call once before serve. Entropy failure is an IO failure, not a constant-token fallback.
app_request_budget: Before serve choose0 to serve until terminated, or1..1000000000 processed connections. Default4096. Choice freezes when serve begins. Other connection/request/deadline limits remain.
app_serve: Bind127.0.0.1 ephemeralport, print exact URL, dispatch admitted requests to app_dispatch(fd):IO. Import app-server and ui; app supplies its callback. Private loopback app, not public production server.
app_form: Preferred POST admission: let seen=try app_form(fd,allowed,values). If seen==0 return ok(0): a400/403 rejection was already sent; NEVER mutate. Nonzero is parsed field mask. Transport errors propagate. App still enforces route and exact action-specific masks.
form_parse: Lower-level parser sends NO HTTP error response. Returns seen mask or IO error. Field k uses values[k*2] pointer and values[k*2+1] length. Keys0token,1rev,2action,3date,4start,5end,6name,7id,8source,9data,10room,11appearance. reserve mask1215, cancel135. Validates duplicates, allowed fields and token. Use app_form for status-safe HTTP admission.
form_hidden: Append hidden token and current revision fields. App must also add action/id and labelled room/date/start/end inputs as appropriate.
ui_response: Send the supplied Writer as HTML with explicit HTTP status. Returns scalar1 sent /0 transport failure. DO NOT copy documents_web_body using header length; use this helper. Invalid protocol/form admission must use400/403, business errors may use a visible retained form.
ui_notice: Render useful error-code/saved-state notice into Writer. Does NOT set HTTP status, authorize an action or save data.
ui_input: Render labelled input. Exact arguments are out,name,label,kind,value_pointer,byte_length,hint. No implicit date formatting.
mcp_serve: Legacy2025-11-25 newline JSON RPC: initialize/initialized,ping,tools/list,tools/call, one no-argument tool. App supplies mcp_execute(out:Writer):IO writing a JSON object for its launch-selected path. Tool takes explicit{} only; no path/source/network arguments. Framework owns framing, duplicate/UTF8 checks, protocol/tool error distinction and output compaction. Callback effects require separate read-only review.
records_read: Copy flat Booking row at index into a function-scope Booking record. Recoverable IO outcome, use do try records_read(rows,i,row). rows.length bounds iteration. Do not copy the owned Bookings handle.
ui_begin: Begin standard RF2 Booking HTML and reset Writer. App composes content; no native widgets. ui_end closes markup. Reusable styles are ui_css().
